interventions.detail: Used Python 3.11: numpy==1.24.4 pin has no py3.12 wheel and fails to build (distutils removed)
Pinned paddlepaddle==2.6.2; Paddle 3.x makes predictor look for inference.json but downloaded model is .pdmodel
apt install libgl1 libglib2.0-0t64 for opencv-python (libGL.so.1 missing)
Installed setuptools into the uv venv; paddle imports it at import time
__init__.py appends package dir to sys.path so ppcls absolute 'import ppcls' works under editable install
Set PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 so repo-root paddleclas.py doesn't shadow the installed package when running python from /work/PaddleClas
Python API example uses docs/images/deployment/whl_demo.jpg; real path is docs/images/inference_deployment/whl_demo.jpg
